Third-party libraries bundled in this folder — unmodified builds pulled
from the npm registry, packaged in so the app works with zero internet
access.

xlsx.full.min.js
  Package : xlsx (SheetJS)
  Version : 0.18.5
  License : Apache-2.0
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/xlsx

jspdf.umd.min.js
  Package : jspdf
  Version : 4.2.1
  License : MIT
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/jspdf

html2canvas.min.js
  Package : html2canvas
  Version : 1.4.1
  License : MIT
  Source  : https://www.npmjs.com/package/html2canvas
